kernel: xpsloss.effective_cross_section_depth_averaged (public M3a API), the only package function called

method.kernel_settings: kernel_epsabs, kernel_epsrel, kernel_limit of the row (API defaults 1e-12, 1e-9, 200); every call contains the two window ends
method.partition: uniform split to width <= Gamma_min/2, then bisection until dist(z, P) >= |P| for every candidate z (enumerated roots and the points 0, E0 and the gap edge); outer pieces cut at the switch points a+u, a+v, b+u, b+v with the same rule for z+u and z+v

normal_control.note: RB1 already uses 20 A, so under M04 the call and the values equal the normal version (no width excess is required)

M05a.note: without hole_charge upstream the M3a total is no_hole + 1*hole, i.e. the RB1 value of the same key (same material, window, L, primary and edges)
